s0301.literal: An edict ordered the salt transport offices of Dadu, Hejian, and Shandong also jointly to manage wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other revenue items.
s0301.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dadu, Hejian, and Shandong salt transport offices also to manage wine, vinegar, commercial taxes, and other revenue items.

s0302.literal: Central Secretariat officials requested making Darughachi Mongol-tai of Zhending circuit Darughachi of Baoding circuit; the emperor said: "This is an upright man; I shall entrust him with another great matter separately."
s0302.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat asked to appoint Zhending circuit darughachi Mongol-tai as darughachi of Baoding circuit; the emperor said, "This is an upright man; I shall give him another great task."

s0303.literal: Wang Liangchen's Mongol and Han troops were rewarded with fifty thousand ingots of notes for the merit of receiving submission in Sichuan.
s0303.idiomatic: Wang Liangchen's Mongol and Han troops were rewarded with 50,000 ingots of notes for receiving submission in Sichuan.

s0304.literal: It was ordered that newly submitted prefectures and districts west of Jiading, and the sons of eminent officials of the Tian and Yang families, all serve as hostages at court.
s0304.idiomatic: It was ordered that newly submitted prefectures and districts west of Jiading, and the sons of eminent officials of the Tian and Yang families, all serve as hostages at court.

s0305.literal: The imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
s0305.idiomatic: The imperial carriage went to Shangdu.

s0306.literal: On yisi day Guo Shoujing, associate director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau, was ordered to seek out and recruit those skilled in astronomy and calendrical computation.
s0306.idiomatic: On yisi day Guo Shoujing, associate director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau, was ordered to seek out experts in astronomy and calendrical computation.

s0307.literal: A judicial inspection commission was established for the Western Sichuan Sichuan circuit.
s0307.idiomatic: A judicial inspection commission was established for the Western Sichuan circuit.

s0308.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial rites on the emperor's behalf to the mountains, rivers, and earth deity.
s0308.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial rites on the emperor's behalf to the mountains, rivers, and earth deity.

s0309.literal: An edict ordered that revenue items of Henan, Western Capital, Northern Capital, and other circuits be placed under the respective circuit pacification commissions.
s0309.idiomatic: An edict placed revenue items of Henan, Western Capital, Northern Capital, and other circuits under their respective circuit pacification commissions.

s0310.literal: Western Sichuan newly submitted troops were rewarded with three thousand eight hundred fifty ingots of notes.
s0310.idiomatic: Western Sichuan newly submitted troops were rewarded with 3,850 ingots of notes.

s0311.literal: Because Mongol troops within Hotan territory were depleted, Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were granted horses, cattle, and sheep, and paper currency for horses and donkeys, clothing, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles, each according to rank.
s0311.idiomatic: Because Mongol troops in Hotan territory were depleted, Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were granted horses, cattle, and sheep, plus paper currency for horses and donkeys, clothing, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles, each according to rank.

s0312.literal: Third month, wushen new moon: an edict forbade hunting at Guide, Bo, Shou, Linhuai, and other places.
s0312.idiomatic: Third month, wushen new moon: an edict forbade hunting at Guide, Bo, Shou, Linhuai, and other places.

s0313.literal: On gengxu day Guo Shoujing was commanded to travel from Shangdu and Dadu, passing through Henan prefecture to the Southern Sea, to measure and test shadow lengths.
s0313.idiomatic: On gengxu day Guo Shoujing was commanded to travel from Shangdu and Dadu, through Henan prefecture to the Southern Sea, to measure shadow lengths.

s0314.literal: On renzi day Nangadai mustered six hundred newly submitted artisan troops from the two Huai regions who made Muslim-style catapults, and all Mongols, Muslims, Han Chinese, and newly submitted persons who could make catapults were sent to the capital.
s0314.idiomatic: On renzi day Nangadai mustered 600 newly submitted artisan troops from the two Huai regions who made Muslim-style catapults, and all Mongols, Muslims, Han Chinese, and newly submitted persons who could make catapults were sent to the capital.

s0315.literal: On gengshen day plowing oxen and implements were issued to the batu troops and Tu-hun River troops under qianhu Ma-nai for garrison farming.
s0315.idiomatic: On gengshen day plowing oxen and implements were issued to the batu troops and Tu-hun River troops under qianhu Ma-nai for garrison farming.

s0316.literal: On bingyin day the Central Secretariat was commanded: all clerks whose documents were delayed one or two days were to be beaten; three days, death.
s0316.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Central Secretariat was commanded that clerks whose documents were delayed one or two days were to be beaten, and three days' delay meant death.

s0317.literal: On jiaxu day the Tanzhou branch secretariat sent Liu Jichang of the Two Huai pacification command headquarters to recruit the various southwestern barbarian peoples; Long Fang-ling and others were made pacification commissioners of Xiaolong fan and other places, with three thousand troops stationed as garrison.
s0317.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Tanzhou branch secretariat sent Liu Jichang of the Two Huai pacification command to recruit the southwestern barbarian peoples; Long Fang-ling and others were made pacification commissioners of Xiaolong fan and other places, with 3,000 troops garrisoned there.

s0318.literal: The Central Secretariat transmitted to the Temple of Imperial Ancestors for study of the county and prefecture soil-and-grain altar system; ritual officials weighed earlier ages, consulted the Book of Rites, fixed sacrificial ritual and regulations for altars and sacrificial vessels, illustrated them in a book titled General Rites for County and Prefecture Soil-and-Grain Altars of the Zhiyuan era, and submitted it.
s0318.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat sent the matter to the Temple of Imperial Ancestors to study county and prefecture soil-and-grain altar systems; ritual officials weighed earlier ages, consulted the Book of Rites, fixed sacrificial ritual and regulations for altars and sacrificial vessels, illustrated them in a book titled General Rites for County and Prefecture Soil-and-Grain Altars of the Zhiyuan era, and submitted it.

s0319.literal: Because Baoding circuit suffered drought, that year's land tax was reduced by three thousand one hundred twenty shi.
s0319.idiomatic: Because Baoding circuit suffered drought, that year's land tax was reduced by 3,120 shi.

s0320.literal: Summer, fourth month, jimao day: a Jiangxi tea monopoly transport office and circuit salt transport offices and commercial tax supervisory offices were established.
s0320.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, jimao day: a Jiangxi tea monopoly transport office and circuit salt transport and commercial tax supervisory offices were established.

s0321.literal: On guisi day the supervising secretary was concurrently made recorder of imperial activity, in charge of memorials and reports from all offices at court.
s0321.idiomatic: On guisi day the supervising secretary was concurrently made recorder of imperial activity, in charge of memorials and reports from all offices at court.

s0322.literal: On wuxu day Darughachi Atachi of Chizhou circuit was promoted to pacification commissioner for battle achievements, concurrently commanding his army's wanhu.
s0322.idiomatic: On wuxu day Chizhou circuit darughachi Atachi was promoted to pacification commissioner for battle achievements, concurrently commanding his army's wanhu.

s0323.literal: On guimao day Saturn infringed upon Jianbi.
s0323.idiomatic: On guimao day Saturn infringed upon Jianbi.

s0324.literal: On yisi day Wang Liangchen said: "Formerly Zan Shun's troops attacked Chengdu and carried off its people to return with them.
s0324.idiomatic: On yisi day Wang Liangchen said, "Formerly Zan Shun's troops attacked Chengdu and carried off its people.

s0325.literal: Now that Jiading has submitted, the people ought to be returned to Chengdu.
s0325.idiomatic: Now that Jiading has submitted, the people ought to be returned to Chengdu.

s0327.literal: " Four thousand Shangdu troops were commanded to guard the capital; all garrison forces that had come from elsewhere were sent back.
s0327.idiomatic: " Four thousand Shangdu troops were ordered to guard the capital, and all garrison forces that had come from elsewhere were sent back.

s0328.literal: Following Suodu's request, Quanzhou monks were ordered to pay taxes according to Song precedent to supply military provisions.
s0328.idiomatic: Following Suodu's request, Quanzhou monks were ordered to pay taxes according to Song precedent to supply military provisions.

s0329.literal: An edict instructed the Yangzhou branch secretariat to select twenty thousand elite southern troops for the imperial guard, send their families to the capital as well, and grant travel expense notes of sixteen thousand ingots.
s0329.idiomatic: An edict instructed the Yangzhou branch secretariat to select 20,000 elite southern troops for the imperial guard, send their families to the capital, and grant 16,000 ingots of notes for travel expenses.

s0330.literal: Locusts appeared in Dadu and fifteen other circuits.
s0330.idiomatic: Locusts appeared in Dadu and 15 other circuits.

s0331.literal: Fifth month, jiyou day: the Central Secretariat requested restoring tiger tallies to pacification commission officials; not granted.
s0331.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiyou day: the Central Secretariat asked to restore tiger tallies to pacification commission officials; the request was denied.

s0332.literal: They also requested that each circuit establish one supervisory commissioner, one associate supervisory commissioner, and one vice supervisory commissioner each, exclusively in charge of revenue items; granted.
s0332.idiomatic: They also asked each circuit to establish one supervisory commissioner, one associate supervisory commissioner, and one vice supervisory commissioner, each exclusively in charge of revenue items; granted.

s0333.literal: On xinhai day Pu Shougang requested issuing an edict to recruit overseas foreign peoples; not granted.
s0333.idiomatic: On xinhai day Pu Shougang asked for an edict to recruit overseas foreign peoples; the request was denied.

s0334.literal: An edict instructed officials, soldiers, and people of Zhang, Quan, Ting, Shaowu, and other places and eighty-four She settlements: if they could lead their groups to submit, officials would receive promotion and rewards by precedent, and soldiers and people would remain settled as before.
s0334.idiomatic: An edict instructed officials, soldiers, and people of Zhang, Quan, Ting, Shaowu, and other places and 84 She settlements: if they could lead their groups to submit, officials would receive promotion and rewards by precedent, and soldiers and people would remain settled as before.

s0335.literal: Because Quanzhou had suffered Zhang Shijie's troops, this year's land tax and levies were reduced by half.
s0335.idiomatic: Because Quanzhou had suffered Zhang Shijie's troops, this year's land tax and levies were reduced by half.

s0336.literal: On bingchen day, because Wutai monks often hid runaway slaves and tax-delinquent people, the Western Capital pacification commission and inspection commission were commanded to search them out.
s0336.idiomatic: On bingchen day, because Wutai monks often hid runaway slaves and tax-delinquent people, the Western Capital pacification commission and inspection commission were ordered to search them out.

s0337.literal: It was ordered that within Uighur territory taxes be paid by calculated mu.
s0337.idiomatic: It was ordered that within Uighur territory taxes be paid by calculated mu.

s0338.literal: Because circuit inspection commissions covered wide territory with heavy business, agricultural encouragement officials were incorporated into the inspection commissions, with one additional vice commissioner and one additional judicial secretary each, concurrently in charge of agricultural encouragement and waterworks.
s0338.idiomatic: Because circuit inspection commissions covered wide territory with heavy business, agricultural encouragement officials were incorporated into the inspection commissions, with one additional vice commissioner and one additional judicial secretary each, concurrently in charge of agricultural encouragement and waterworks.

s0339.literal: On jiazi day censors memorialized: "Previously Secretariat official Ariboke said that when punishing offenders, censors and provincial officials should jointly intimidate and interrogate together; an edict granted this.
s0339.idiomatic: On jiazi day censors memorialized, "Previously Secretariat official Ariboke said that when punishing offenders, censors and provincial officials should jointly intimidate and interrogate together; an edict granted this.

s0340.literal: We consider that branch secretariats decide guilt arbitrarily; how can the branch censorate correct them?
s0340.idiomatic: We consider that branch secretariats decide guilt arbitrarily; how can the branch censorate correct them?

s0341.literal: It is appropriate for the branch secretariat to finish questioning first, and then for inspection to follow.
s0341.idiomatic: It is appropriate for the branch secretariat to finish questioning first, and then for inspection to follow.

s0343.literal: " Gao Xing had misappropriated thirty-one thousand one hundred odd taels of gold and two hundred fifty thousand six hundred taels of silver belonging to the two Song princes; an edict dispatched envoys to pursue recovery.
s0343.idiomatic: " Gao Xing had misappropriated 31,100-odd taels of gold and 250,600 taels of silver belonging to the two Song princes; an edict dispatched envoys to pursue recovery.

s0344.literal: An edict ordered Lian, Hai, and other prefectures to recruit people for garrison farming, establishing a general administration office and a supervisory office to direct it.
s0344.idiomatic: An edict ordered Lian, Hai, and other prefectures to recruit people for garrison farming, establishing a general administration office and a supervisory office to direct it.

s0345.literal: On yichou day ten thousand batu households of Jiangling and other circuits were commanded: for every qianhu one Darughachi was placed, directly subordinate to the secretariat and ministries.
s0345.idiomatic: On yichou day 10,000 batu households of Jiangling and other circuits were registered: for every qianhu one darughachi was placed, directly subordinate to the secretariat and ministries.

s0346.literal: On bingyin day Jiangnan Buddhist office documents were commanded not to be casually placed in the courier system.
s0346.idiomatic: On bingyin day Jiangnan Buddhist office documents were ordered not to be casually placed in the courier system.

s0347.literal: Ten relay stations including Lintao, Gongchang, and Tong'an: without the sea-eagle tally, riding the courier network was forbidden.
s0347.idiomatic: At ten relay stations including Lintao, Gongchang, and Tong'an, riding the courier network was forbidden without the sea-eagle tally.

s0348.literal: On dingmao day Baoshan and Langqu counties of Yunnan were changed to prefectures.
s0348.idiomatic: On dingmao day Baoshan and Langqu counties of Yunnan were changed to prefectures.

s0349.literal: On jisi day an edict ordered relay station households along the routes: for all traveling envoys who should not ride the courier network, people, livestock, food, drink, and fodder were not to be supplied.
s0349.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered relay station households along the routes not to supply people, livestock, food, drink, or fodder to traveling envoys who should not ride the courier network.

s0350.literal: At Wandu and seven Henan relay stations the people were impoverished; they were granted one thousand eight hundred ingots of notes for horses, cattle, and sheep.
s0350.idiomatic: At Wandu and seven Henan relay stations the people were impoverished; they were granted 1,800 ingots of notes for horses, cattle, and sheep.

s0351.literal: On gengwu day Nemytai was granted rewards for battle merit, and troops who besieged Chongqing and pacification commissioner Liu Jichang and others were granted notes and clothing, each according to rank.
s0351.idiomatic: On gengwu day Nemytai was rewarded for battle merit, and troops who besieged Chongqing and pacification commissioner Liu Jichang and others were granted notes and clothing, each according to rank.

s0352.literal: On renshen day Lü Hu came to submit; he was appointed prefect of Shunqing prefecture, granted a tiger tally, and given fifty ingots of notes.
s0352.idiomatic: On renshen day Lü Hu came to submit; he was appointed prefect of Shunqing prefecture, granted a tiger tally, and given 50 ingots of notes.

s0353.literal: Ten thousand imperial guard troops stationed at Dingzi Valley were transferred to garrison farm at Changping.
s0353.idiomatic: Ten thousand imperial guard troops stationed at Dingzi Valley were transferred to garrison farm at Changping.

s0354.literal: On guiyou day Uryangqadai said: "Both Beijing and Western Capital ox-carts have arrived; military grain can be transported.
s0354.idiomatic: On guiyou day Uryangqadai said, "Both Beijing and Western Capital ox-carts have arrived; military grain can be transported.

s0355.literal: " The emperor said: "You do not inquire into the people's hardship, but only know how to conscript the people.
s0355.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "You do not inquire into the people's hardship, but only know how to conscript the people.

s0356.literal: If everything is taken this year, how will next year's crops be planted?
s0356.idiomatic: If everything is taken this year, how will next year's crops be planted?

s0358.literal: " On jiaxu day two thousand oxen for craftsmen under Yao Suh he were issued, and they were ordered at once to transport two thousand shi of grain for the army.
s0358.idiomatic: " On jiaxu day 2,000 oxen for craftsmen under Yao Suh he were issued, and they were ordered at once to transport 2,000 shi of grain for the army.

s0359.literal: An edict instructed Tu'erchi and others to manage commercial taxes of Ganzhou circuit; no one was to obstruct or harass them.
s0359.idiomatic: An edict instructed Tu'erchi and others to manage commercial taxes of Ganzhou circuit; no one was to obstruct or harass them.

s0360.literal: The Tanzhou branch secretariat memorialized: "Qiongzhou pacification commissioner Ma Wang had already recruited four overseas prefectures to submit; soon local bandits Huang Weiyuan and three others made trouble, and have now been captured.
s0360.idiomatic: The Tanzhou branch secretariat memorialized, "Qiongzhou pacification commissioner Ma Wang had already recruited four overseas prefectures to submit; soon local bandits Huang Weiyuan and three others made trouble, and have now been captured.

s0361.literal: " An edict ordered the extreme penalty for them.
s0361.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the extreme penalty for them.

s0362.literal: On bingzi day the Hongji Duke of the Sanggan River was advanced in enfeoffment to Manifest Response Hongji Duke.
s0362.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Hongji Duke of the Sanggan River was advanced in enfeoffment to Manifest Response Hongji Duke.

s0363.literal: Master Zhang Liusun was ordered to perform Daoist rites at the traveling palace, presenting red memorials to Heaven, for five days and nights in all.
s0363.idiomatic: Master Zhang Liusun was ordered to perform Daoist rites at the traveling palace, presenting red memorials to Heaven, for five days and nights in all.

s0364.literal: Princes Aoluchi, Boladai, and others and troops under qianhu Bayatu and Hezhou relay households were granted sheep, horses, and notes, each according to rank.
s0364.idiomatic: Princes Aoluchi, Boladai, and others and troops under qianhu Bayatu and Hezhou relay households were granted sheep, horses, and notes, each according to rank.

s0365.literal: Sixth month, dingchou new moon: Ahmad said: "Changzhou circuit Darughachi Ma Shu reported forty illegal acts by High Commissioner of the Western Zhejiang inspection commission Gao Yuan; Yuan also impeached Shu.
s0365.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingchou new moon: Ahmad said, "Changzhou circuit darughachi Ma Shu reported forty illegal acts by Western Zhejiang inspection commissioner Gao Yuan; Yuan also impeached Shu.

s0366.literal: " When the matter was reported, an edict ordered court debate.
s0366.idiomatic: " When the matter was reported, an edict ordered court debate.

s0367.literal: An edict ordered five hundred newly submitted troops, one hundred Mongol troops, and four hundred Han troops dispatched to garrison Diaomen, Yutong, Li, and Ya.
s0367.idiomatic: An edict ordered 500 newly submitted troops, 100 Mongol troops, and 400 Han troops dispatched to garrison Diaomen, Yutong, Li, and Ya.

s0368.literal: An edict instructed the prince's chancellery and Sichuan branch secretariat: four circuit pacification commissions were to soothe and govern the various Man tribes of southwestern Bochuan and Wuchuan; officials, soldiers, and people each were to follow their own customs without losing normal livelihood.
s0368.idiomatic: An edict instructed the prince's chancellery and Sichuan branch secretariat that four circuit pacification commissions were to soothe and govern the various Man tribes of southwestern Bochuan and Wuchuan; officials, soldiers, and people were each to follow their own customs without losing normal livelihood.

s0369.literal: On renwu day, because Eastern Zhejiang pacification commissioner Chen You died in royal service, his son Kui was made general troop commander, granted a tiger tally.
s0369.idiomatic: On renwu day, because Eastern Zhejiang pacification commissioner Chen You died in royal service, his son Kui was made general troop commander and granted a tiger tally.

s0370.literal: On jiashen day one hundred fifty-eight officers and commanders under Song Zhang Shijie came to Qiong, Lei, and other prefectures to submit.
s0370.idiomatic: On jiashen day 158 officers and commanders under Song Zhang Shijie came to Qiong, Lei, and other prefectures to submit.

s0371.literal: It was commanded to build warships to campaign against Japan; because materials and supplies came from Goryeo, they were to be manufactured there; the King of Goryeo was ordered to consider convenience and report.
s0371.idiomatic: It was commanded to build warships to campaign against Japan; because materials and supplies came from Goryeo, they were to be manufactured there, and the King of Goryeo was ordered to consider convenience and report.

s0372.literal: On yiyou day at Yulin, Hongzan, and Diaowo relay stations, each station was supplemented with one hundred fifty horses and two hundred carts, with oxen in the same number as carts issued.
s0372.idiomatic: On yiyou day at Yulin, Hongzan, and Diaowo relay stations, each station was supplemented with 150 horses and 200 carts, with oxen in the same number as carts issued.

s0373.literal: On bingxu day locust larvae appeared in the garrison farms of the Left and Right Guards.
s0373.idiomatic: On bingxu day locust larvae appeared in the garrison farms of the Left and Right Guards.

s0374.literal: On gengyin day Jining prefecture was promoted to a circuit.
s0374.idiomatic: On gengyin day Jining prefecture was promoted to a circuit.

s0375.literal: On renchen day Vice Minister of State and Henan circuit pacification commissioner Husain was made left vice minister of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs.
s0375.idiomatic: On renchen day Vice Minister of State and Henan circuit pacification commissioner Husain was made left vice minister of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of branch secretariat affairs.

s0376.literal: On guisi day twenty thousand newly submitted troops were distributed among six guards for garrison farming.
s0376.idiomatic: On guisi day 20,000 newly submitted troops were distributed among six guards for garrison farming.

s0377.literal: Cherem Temur said many of his unit's soldiers were robbed by bandits and property plundered, but the authorities did not promptly adjudicate; he begged officials be sent to investigate; an edict ordered Urudai to go and handle it.
s0377.idiomatic: Cherem Temur said many of his unit's soldiers were robbed by bandits and property plundered, but the authorities did not promptly adjudicate; he begged officials be sent to investigate; an edict ordered Urudai to go and handle it.

s0378.literal: Buqa was placed in charge of Western Sichuan branch privy council affairs, gathering troops to enter Sichuan and pacify Song cities not yet taken.
s0378.idiomatic: Buqa was placed in charge of Western Sichuan branch privy council affairs, gathering troops to enter Sichuan and pacify Song cities not yet taken.

s0379.literal: The Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council was still ordered to mobilize troops to garrison Diaoyu Mountain fortress.
s0379.idiomatic: The Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council was still ordered to mobilize troops to garrison Diaoyu Mountain fortress.

s0380.literal: With Western Sichuan pacified, garrison farming was re-established; military officers were promoted by graded merit; in all one hundred sixty-one received appointment edicts and gold and silver tallies.
s0380.idiomatic: With Western Sichuan pacified, garrison farming was re-established; military officers were promoted by graded merit; in all 161 received appointment edicts and gold and silver tallies.

s0381.literal: An edict ordered newly submitted households of Tengchuan county, Gaozhou and Junlian prefectures to establish relay stations along roads maintained at Xuzhou and other places.
s0381.idiomatic: An edict ordered newly submitted households of Tengchuan county, Gaozhou and Junlian prefectures to establish relay stations along roads maintained at Xuzhou and other places.

s0382.literal: Yunnan commander-in-chief Ailu and Nasir al-Din recruited southwestern countries to submit.
s0382.idiomatic: Yunnan commander-in-chief Ailu and Nasir al-Din recruited southwestern countries to submit.

s0383.literal: Ailu led troops separately to pacify Yiqibuxie; Nasir al-Din led Dali troops to the borders within Jinch'i, Piao, Qucan, and Burma, recruiting three hundred stockades including Mangmu and Jumutu, registering one hundred ten thousand two hundred households.
s0383.idiomatic: Ailu led troops separately to pacify Yiqibuxie; Nasir al-Din led Dali troops to the borders within Jinch'i, Piao, Qucan, and Burma, recruiting 300 stockades including Mangmu and Jumutu, registering 110,200 households.

s0384.literal: An edict fixed land tax and rent, established relay posts, and set up escort guard troops.
s0384.idiomatic: An edict fixed land tax and rent, established relay posts, and set up escort guard troops.

s0385.literal: When the army returned, twelve tame elephants were presented.
s0385.idiomatic: When the army returned, 12 tame elephants were presented.

s0386.literal: On wuxu day Longmen township of Xuande prefecture was changed back to a county.
s0386.idiomatic: On wuxu day Longmen township of Xuande prefecture was changed back to a county.

s0387.literal: On gengzi day unregistered households of Hexi and Western Tibet were mustered and registered.
s0387.idiomatic: On gengzi day unregistered households of Hexi and Western Tibet were mustered and registered.

s0388.literal: On xinchou day, because the Tongzhou water route was shallow and transport by boat very difficult, the Privy Council was ordered to dispatch five thousand troops, and salaried officials were also ordered to hire one thousand laborers for dredging, to be completed in fifty days.
s0388.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because the Tongzhou water route was shallow and transport by boat very difficult, the Privy Council was ordered to dispatch 5,000 troops, and salaried officials were also ordered to hire 1,000 laborers for dredging, to be completed in 50 days.

s0389.literal: On guimao day, because the ten relay stations including Lintao, Gongchang, and Tong'an suffered yearly famine and heavy corvee, with some pawning and selling children to meet service obligations, officials were selected to soothe and govern.
s0389.idiomatic: On guimao day, because the ten relay stations including Lintao, Gongchang, and Tong'an suffered yearly famine and heavy corvee, with some pawning and selling children to meet service obligations, officials were selected to soothe and govern.

s0390.literal: On jiachen day four hundred Xiangyang garrison-farming households were ordered to replace troops in performing relay service.
s0390.idiomatic: On jiachen day 400 Xiangyang garrison-farming households were ordered to replace troops in performing relay service.

s0391.literal: Northern campaign Mongol troops including Kokebad who fought with merit were granted fifty taels of silver; families of those killed in battle received one hundred taels of silver; those in the ranks received one ingot of notes; other clothing rewards varied by rank.
s0391.idiomatic: Northern campaign Mongol troops including Kokebad who fought with merit were granted 50 taels of silver; families of those killed in battle received 100 taels of silver; those in the ranks received one ingot of notes; other clothing rewards varied by rank.

s0392.literal: Hunting was forbidden in the various valleys and stockades of Bayan Cher.
s0392.idiomatic: Hunting was forbidden in the various valleys and stockades of Bayan Cher.

s0393.literal: An edict remitted Sichuan labor and tax levies.
s0393.idiomatic: An edict remitted Sichuan labor and tax levies.

s0394.literal: Vice Minister of State and branch secretariat affairs Bedruddin was made Henan circuit pacification commissioner.
s0394.idiomatic: Vice Minister of State and branch secretariat affairs Bedruddin was made Henan circuit pacification commissioner.

s0395.literal: Ahmad's son Husain was made left vice minister of the Tanzhou branch secretariat; Husain Hajib and others were all restored to their former posts.
s0395.idiomatic: Ahmad's son Husain was made left vice minister of the Tanzhou branch secretariat; Husain Hajib and others were all restored to their former posts.

s0396.literal: Champa, Ma'bar, and other countries dispatched envoys presenting rare goods and one elephant and rhinoceros horn each.
s0396.idiomatic: Champa, Ma'bar, and other countries dispatched envoys presenting rare goods and one elephant and rhinoceros horn each.

s0397.literal: Princes' subordinates were granted silver, notes, clothing, silks and brocades, saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, and paper currency for sheep and horses, each according to rank.
s0397.idiomatic: Princes' subordinates were granted silver, notes, clothing, silks and brocades, saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, and paper currency for sheep and horses, each according to rank.

s0398.literal: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Mountain.
s0398.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Mountain.

s0399.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wushen day: Ningguo circuit newly submitted troops company commander Zhan Fu plotted rebellion; Fu was sentenced to death; informer He Shiqing was made zongba with a silver tally and granted ten ingots of notes.
s0399.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, wushen day: Ningguo circuit newly submitted troops company commander Zhan Fu plotted rebellion; Fu was sentenced to death; informer He Shiqing was made zongba with a silver tally and granted 10 ingots of notes.

s0400.literal: The Western Sichuan branch secretariat was abolished.
s0400.idiomatic: The Western Sichuan branch secretariat was abolished.
